instruction: I am an NLP researcher compiling award data. Look up the ACL 2019 best paper award on the ACL Anthology website and add a complete entry to the table best_awards_acl.xlsx on the desktop. Make sure to fill in all four columns: title, year, author list (comma-separated), and ACL Anthology PDF link. Do not leave any field empty.
